Is there a possibility that introducing changes to Subversion will disrupt other functions?

timeline.author: mxsm

timeline.body:
> Is there a possibility that introducing changes to Subversion will disrupt other functions?

1. The generation of subversion only made changes to the client side, and no changes were made to the broker side. 
2. The expiration and removal of SubscriptionData is handled through the newly added lastUpdateTime.

reply.body: I don’t think it’s necessary. The lastUpdateTime is generated on the server where the Broker is located. Even if the client generates it, it will not be serialized and sent to the Broker, so there is no problem with changes

Heatbeat does not update the timestamp of subscriptionData in broker. It updated at pullRequest. so the consumer group will not be removed in removeExpireConsumerGroupInfo. The above modification is correct, IMO.
